description: General-cheating (off-domain) minimal pair. Assembly by format: template/third_person/first_person -> the text alone; judgment -> user message = text + '\n\nWas this fair?' (appended in code); ai_offdomain -> chat [user: shared_context, assistant: text] with the <think> block rendered as the model's reasoning.

plan.description: Scratch plan, at most 60 words. Discarded.

shared_context.description: gc_ai_offdomain: the user's request (shared). Every other format: empty string.

text_a.description: Branch A text: the act breaks the rules or games the measure.

text_b.description: Branch B text: identical except the act is legitimate effort toward the same goal.

span_a.description: Verbatim clause of text_a stating the act; 3-20 words; appears exactly once.

span_b.description: Verbatim clause of text_b at the same position; 3-20 words; appears exactly once.
